profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
With a robust foundation in computer software engineering from General Assembly, my journey at Abenity as a Backend Developer sharpened my skills in Vue Framework and agile project management. Our team maintained nine applications, seamlessly fixing over a hundred bugs, which honed my ability to collaborate effectively and innovate under pressure.

The experience at Biscuitville Fresh Southern as a Shift Lead prior to my tech career instilled in me a strong leadership acumen, which transitioned smoothly into my role in tech, enabling me to contribute to cross-functional team success. My drive is fueled by a passion for creating user-centric solutions and the continuous pursuit of technological mastery.
